note: A cell is a (labeler, product code) series, which is the unit CMS suppresses. The ceiling for a suppressed market-quarter is ten prescriptions for each cell that was dispensing into the market in the four quarters before the exit, which is the most the primary rule allows that quarter to have held. Secondary suppression can withhold a cell to protect another, so even this is not a guaranteed bound. The last three figures are the collapse count under zero imputation, under ten prescriptions per market-quarter, and under the per-quarter ceiling.
